name: Pre-packaged commodity (general)
description: Default category: any retail-sale pre-packaged commodity not covered by a more specific category below, and not excluded by rule 3.

name: Pre-packaged food article
description: Food articles - declarations under rule 6(1)(a) name/address are carved out in favour of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Explanation III to 6(1)(a)).

name: Cosmetics
description: Packages containing cosmetic products - Drugs & Cosmetics Rules, 1945 apply alongside PCR (per project notes; not independently re-verified this session).

name: Medical devices
description: Packages containing medical devices - Medical Devices Rules, 2017 govern declarations (rule 2(h) proviso), letter height/width (rule 7(2)/(3) provisos), and rule-33 relaxation is disapplied (rule 33(2)).

name: Price-controlled pharmaceutical formulations
description: Scheduled/non-scheduled formulations under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 2013 - exempt under rule 26(c), EXCEPT medical devices declared as drugs.

name: Garments / hosiery
description: Garment or hosiery commodities; rule 26(f) permits loose/open sale exempt from standard packaging declarations subject to 4 on-product disclosures.

name: Pan masala
description: Pan masala packages - rule 26(a)'s general exemption explicitly does NOT apply (2025 amendment, effective 1-Feb-2026).

name: Edible oils & fats
description: Subject to the DCA's dedicated Net Quantity Determination SOP (SRC-019).

name: Electronic products
description: Had a transitional (now expired) QR-code alternative for name/address and generic-name declarations (rule 6(1)(a)/(b) provisos, AMD-2022-577).

name: Alcoholic beverages / spirituous liquor
description: MRP and unit-sale-price declarations follow applicable State Excise law within the manufacturing state, where that law itself provides for such a declaration.

name: LPG cylinders (PSU-filled), bidi, agarbatti
description: Referenced in the principal rules as exempted from the manufacture month/year declaration requirement (needs verification against SRC-001 full text).

name: Agricultural farm produce
description: Farm produce packages up to 50 kg ARE covered by PCR 2011 (confirmed by DCA advisory SRC-012); only bags ABOVE 50 kg are excluded under rule 3(b), alongside cement and fertilizer.

name: Industrial / institutional consumer packages
description: Packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers are wholly excluded from Chapter II under rule 3(c).

name: Bulk packages > 25 kg / 25 litre
description: Excluded from Chapter II under rule 3(a).

name: E-commerce product listing
description: Not a physical package category but a digital-listing surface: rule 6(10) (mandatory declarations must be shown online) and rule 6(10A) (country-of-origin searchable/sortable filter for imported products, effective 1-Jul-2027) attach here.

name: Imported products
description: Country-of-origin declaration (rule 6(1)(aa)), e-commerce COO filter (rule 6(10A)), and bonded-warehouse declaration timing (rule 4 Explanation-2) all key off import status.

name: Combination / group packages
description: Rule 2(ka)/(kb): packages bundling multiple dissimilar (combination) or similar-but-not-identical (group) commodities/pieces together for retail sale.

name: Wholesale package
description: Governed by Rule 18 rather than the retail-sale rule 6 declarations.

name: Vehicle fuel tank capacity (advisory only)
description: Covered by a DCA advisory (SRC-013) about safety-margin tank capacity in service manuals; not itself a PCR rule change - RAG/explanatory reference only.
